incident_location: Cedar Ridge Clinic, Bellevue, staff room
summary: Staff-room heat pump failed almost a month before the site reported it
story: The staff-room heat pump stopped heating on September 30, and the site filed the escalation on October 28. The site used a space heater in the meantime, so no clinic work stopped. The filing window is 14 days with 2 days of grace, and the report is outside both.

items.description: Check the heat pump breaker and filter with the site

documents.name: Facilities note from the site
documents.content: Cedar Ridge site note, October 28, 2026. The staff-room heat pump stopped heating around September 30. A space heater covers the room. The breaker is on and the filter is clean.

incident_location: Harbor Point Clinic, Tacoma, pharmacy door
summary: Pharmacy door reader rejects cards again after the October fix
story: The pharmacy door reader at Harbor Point rejects every card since October 21. The platform team fixed the same reader's provisioning on October 6, and the door worked from October 6 to October 20. The site rebooted the reader twice without change. Harbor Point is on the priority tier and asks for an escalation with the October history attached.

items.description: Confirm the reader fault with the pharmacy lead
Escalate the reader fault with the October fix history

documents.name: Platform team fix note of October 6
documents.content: Platform note, October 6, 2026. The pharmacy door reader at Harbor Point rejected cards after a provisioning sync. The team cleared the stale record and the reader worked the same afternoon.
